name: B10-0060/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission implementing decision authorising the placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified maize MON 95275 pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission not to allow a type of genetically modified maize, called MON 95275, onto the EU market for food and feed. Parliament says the safety checks were incomplete, especially on effects on other insects, soil and wild plants. It wants the Commission to withdraw its draft approval and bring a new proposal back to the committee of Member State representatives. This is Parliament's opinion; it does not itself change the law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks the Commission to withdraw the draft approval.
- **Who it affects:** Companies selling this maize, farmers, food and feed businesses, and consumers in the EU.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to withdraw, change or keep its draft decision.
